question: Let $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ be arbitrary integers and suppose $b_1,\ldots,b_n$ is a permutation of the $a_i$\textquotesingle$s. Then the value $|a_1-b_1|+|a_2-b_2|+\cdots+|a_n-b_n|$

options.A: is less than or equal to $n$;
options.B: can be an arbitrary positive integer;
options.C: can be any even nonnegative integer;
